sections.paragraph: At VirtualAssistant.com.au, we understand that podiatry clinics need to balance clinical care with patient communication and admin. Our AI Virtual Receptionist is designed to do exactly that — handling phone calls, booking appointments, and answering patient questions while you stay focused on treatments. From general foot care to orthotic therapy, your AI Receptionist ensures patients always feel supported and informed.

Your AI Receptionist can manage new patient inquiries, reschedule appointments, and handle cancellations automatically. It can respond to questions like ‘Do you treat heel pain?’ or ‘Can I claim my visit through private health?’ with natural, accurate answers — creating a professional first impression for every patient.

sections.subheading: Never Miss a Patient or Referral
sections.paragraph: Whether you’re performing a biomechanical assessment, fitting orthotics, or managing diabetic foot care, your AI Receptionist ensures every call is answered. It can share information about your services, explain your consultation process, and confirm bookings directly in your schedule. You’ll never miss a new patient lead or important follow-up again.

It integrates seamlessly with your booking system, provides accurate responses, and helps maintain your clinic’s reputation for efficiency and care. Best of all, your AI Receptionist can be trained specifically to your business requirements — ensuring every interaction matches your brand, tone, and workflow. leftBox.heading: Streamlined Client Notes and Progress Tracking
leftBox.description: After each session, personal trainers can record short voice memos that are automatically transcribed and summarized — perfect for tracking client progress or noting adjustments for their next session. You can also upload client assessments, progress photos, and nutrition plans. All data is stored securely in your dashboard, making it easy to stay organized and deliver a personalized, professional experience for every client.
